interpretation: Renderer/Material/Mesh/TextureSettings pointers and serialized fields are exact current-JP evidence. privacyBoundary: Raw current-JP AssetBundles remain transient in the Actions temp directory. Only this bounded renderer/mesh/texture metadata report is persisted.
